concerns.text: Task T019 (storage logic) is listed as dependent on T013 and T018, but T016 (simulator config) and T015 (simulator implementation) are listed AFTER T019. The storage task cannot run before the simulator tasks that generate the data it is meant to store. This violates the producer-before-consumer dependency.

Task T027 (writing results to CSV) is listed as a prerequisite for T028 and T029, but T027 depends on the selection methods (T024-T026) and metrics calculation (T028/T029) to have data to write. The order is circular: T027 must run after T028/T029, but T028/T029 are listed as depending on T027. The implementation tasks (T024-T026) must precede the storage task (T027).

Task T037 (Kruskal-Wallis) is marked as dependent on T036 (validation). However, T036 validates the file `data/processed/simulation_results.csv` which is produced by T027 (Phase 4). While T036 is correctly placed before T037, the dependency chain implies T036 runs before T027 completes. The ordering must explicitly ensure Phase 4 (T027) completes before Phase 5 (T036) begins.

Task T045 (Performance optimization) and T046 (Early stopping) are placed in Phase N (Polish), AFTER the main simulation loops in Phase 3 and 4. The plan explicitly states these optimizations are 'necessary to meet the 6-hour runtime' (SC-003). Running the full 24,000 simulations without these optimizations (which are implemented in Phase N) will likely cause the job to fail the runtime constraint before the optimization tasks are ever executed. These tasks must be moved to Phase 2 (Foundational) or Phase 3 (US1) to be available during the simulation execution.

Task T018 (select representative subset) is listed after T013 (fetch datasets) but before T015/T016 (simulation). However, T019 (storage) depends on T018. The flow is: Fetch (T013) -> Select Subset (T018) -> Simulate (T015/T016) -> Store (T019). The current listing order in Phase 3 is T013, T014, T019, T016, T015, T017, T018. T019 is placed before T015/T016/T018, creating a logical impossibility where storage runs before data generation and selection.
Task T016 (simulator config) is listed after T019 (storage) and T015 (simulator implementation). Configuration tasks must precede implementation tasks. T016 should be before T015.
